The '''Model C self-defense pistol''', nicknamed "'''Fiver'''" due to its five-round internal cylinder magazine, was a type of [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]] produced by [[Xet Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
